```sql
SELECT 
    fecha,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN aprobado = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS tasa_aprobacion
FROM pagos
WHERE medio = 'tarjeta' 
    AND fecha >= '2026-03-01' 
    AND fecha <= '2026-03-31'
GROUP BY fecha
ORDER BY fecha;
```
